claim: Email is treestock's best channel per head (43.2% open, 13 of 13 engaged) and behaves nothing like treestock editorial pages. The binding constraint on its value is list size, not content or frequency.

body.correction: resend_engagement.py fetched a single page of 100 and ignored Resend's has_more flag, so a report labelled 90 days was reading 9 (2026-07-21..07-30). It reported 81 sends, 39 opens, 8 clicks, 48.1% open rate, 2 subscribers 'never emailed' and 2 'delivered, no open'. All six figures were wrong. With the full 1,836-email history every subscriber is engaged, and the two listed as never emailed are the two best converters (4/4/3 and 4/3/1 sent/opened/clicked). Nothing was broken in the sending; the measurement was broken. Fixed d45e404, now follows the `after` cursor and raises rather than returning a partial history.
body.implication: Email is the best-performing channel treestock has per head, and behaves nothing like treestock editorial PAGES, which DEC-249 measured at 0.01 outbound clicks/visitor. The binding constraint on its value is list size (13), not content or frequency.
body.open_defect: RESOLVED. Code fixed DEC-251, data restored DEC-257. DAL-260 is Done.
body.delivery_rate_correction: DEC-255: 100% delivered, 0 bounced over 90 days (775 emails). The 52.5% the weekly report printed on 2026-07-30 was a classification bug, not a deliverability problem. resend_engagement.py always classified correctly, so DEC-250's 43.2% open rate stands.
